finding: Five placer seeds on ONE netlist give Fmax 379.65-422.65 MHz, a spread of 11.0% of the median, while the LUT count is identical in all five. Area is seed-invariant here; timing is not. A frequency quoted to 0.01 MHz from an unstated number of seeds is over-precise by three orders of magnitude against its own reproducibility.
